messages:
maria: Heads up — invoice-preview shows a big spike for org_129 between 08:12-08:14 UTC. Preview token delta +48%. Looks like route fallback produced duplicate billing events. Anyone on metering awake?

alan: on it. linked the preview: https://console.redwood/test/invoice/preview?org=org_129 :eyes:

sasha: quick glance at raw events -> same request_id emitted twice with different route tags (primary & fallback) within ~1s. proxy retries + fallback policy? pulling logs now.

alan: quick SQL check I ran:
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) AS cnt
FROM billing_events
WHERE org = 'org_129'
  AND ts BETWEEN '2024-03-10T08:12:00Z' AND '2024-03-10T08:15:00Z'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING cnt > 1
LIMIT 10;
```
returned ~94 duplicated request_ids.

jen: If duplicates are coming from the proxy/fallback path we have options: dedupe in aggregator, or add a finalized flag and prefer latest finalized event. Which is lower blast radius?

kevin: hotfix proposal: in aggregator consumer, drop event if event.fallback == true AND there exists a later finalized event with same request_id within 30s. Minimal state, easy rollback.

sasha: I can push a canary rule to the aggregator consumer. Patch (pseudo):
```py
# aggregator dedupe rule
if event['fallback'] and cache.exists(event['request_id'], finalized=True):
    drop(event)
else:
    forward(event)
```
I'll instrument meter.dedupe.rate and meter.dup_latency.

alan: UX: console preview should surface "suspected duplicates" with a link to raw events. Also add a toggle to hide suspected duplicates in preview. Product asked for clear signal so sales doesn't escalate.

maria: Ops — can you pause preview job for org_129 until canary is in and validated? We should not affect real billing pipelines, just previews.

ops-bot: pause-preview job queued for org_129 (requested by maria). ETA ~90s.

billing-bot: Alert: invoice-preview for org_129 paused by ops (reason: suspected duplicate events).

jen: Canary rolled to 5% of aggregator partitions. telemetry shows initial dedupe events emitted.

sasha: Logs from canary partitions: duplicates for the sample window dropped from 94 -> 2. meter.dedupe.rate shows ~97% reduction in canary.

kevin: Good. Rollout plan: 15 minutes observation, if no regression in finalized events or latency, escalate to 50% then 100%. Revert path: remove rule and clear cache keys.

maria: Also let's add a dashboard card for "fallback-route duplicates" (count and percent of window) and an alert if duplicates > 1% for 5m. Product wants a link on tenant invoice page too.

alan: I'll add the tile and the runbook link: https://runbook.redwood/dup-metering. Will include quick query and rollback steps.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with billing to re-run invoice-preview once canary hits 100%. Billing team wants an audit of previews impacted and a note to customers (if real invoices unchanged).

maria: Thanks all. Please capture a short postmortem if any real invoices are affected. Also update SDK docs about route_hint so downstream teams know fallback tags can be noisy.

kevin: noted — I'll open a follow-up ticket for SDK docs + routing policy review.

maria: Great work — keep updates here.
